 Denver Nuggets 76 – 69 HT Toronto Raptors Live Updated a few seconds ago Nuggets vs Raptors LIVE, Score Updates and Highlights in NBA Game (76-69)
 Follow Denver Nuggets vs Toronto Raptors live score, quarter-by-quarter updates, player stats and how to watch the 2026-27 NBA game on VAVEL.
 Coverage by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta Updated November 4, 2026, 10:27 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 Live Last update 10:27 PM ET 10:24 PM ET 2 minutes ago 3Q | 10:03: Nikola Jokic layup gives Denver Nuggets a 72-69 lead over Toronto
 Collin Murray-Boyles scored in the paint off an Immanuel Quickley assist for the Toronto Raptors before Aaron Gordon answered with a jumper and a layup at 10:29 on two Nikola Jokic assists. After Quickley missed a 26-foot three-pointer at 10:18, Jokic converted a layup off a Jamal Murray feed at 10:03 to give the Denver Nuggets a 72-69 lead. Jokic leads all scorers with 21 points, eight rebounds, and eight assists on 9-of-13 shooting.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 Key moments
 10:20 PM ET 3Q | 11:57: Third quarter begins with Toronto… 
 10:05 PM ET Halftime: RJ Barrett and Nikola Jokic score 17… 
 8:54 PM ET Ball Arena tip-off countdown and NBA standings… 
 Follow VAVEL on Google 10:20 PM ET 7 minutes ago 3Q | 11:57: Third quarter begins with Toronto Raptors up 67-64 on Denver
 The third quarter is underway at 11:57 with the Toronto Raptors holding a 67-64 lead over the Denver Nuggets. Nikola Jokic enters the second half pacing Denver with 17 points on 7-of-11 shooting, seven rebounds, six assists, and two steals. RJ Barrett leads Toronto with 17 points on 5-of-8 from the field and 2-of-3 from three-point range, adding one rebound and one assist.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:14 PM ET 13 minutes ago Halftime Leaders: Scottie Barnes and Aaron Gordon back 17-point halves from RJ Barrett and Nikola Jokic
 RJ Barrett paces the Toronto Raptors at the break with 17 points on 5-of-8 shooting, supported by Scottie Barnes with 13 points, four assists, and three steals, plus 11 points from Collin Murray-Boyles as Toronto leads 67-64. Nikola Jokic tops the Denver Nuggets with 17 points on 7-of-11 shooting, seven rebounds, six assists, and two steals. Aaron Gordon adds 11 points on 4-of-5 shooting while Cameron Johnson has nine points on 3-of-4 shooting from three-point range.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:09 PM ET 18 minutes ago Halftime Stats: Toronto Raptors shoot 59% from the floor to lead Denver Nuggets 67-64
 The Toronto Raptors hold a 67-64 halftime advantage after shooting 26-of-44 from the floor (59%) and 9-of-19 from three-point range (47%). The Denver Nuggets shot 25-of-42 from the field (60%) and 6-of-13 from beyond the arc (46%) across the first two quarters. Denver leads the rebounding count 18-13 at the break, while the Nuggets and the Raptors have recorded 20 assists apiece.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:05 PM ET 22 minutes ago Halftime: RJ Barrett and Nikola Jokic score 17 apiece as Raptors lead Nuggets 67-64
 RJ Barrett knocked down three free throws at 33.6 seconds before Aaron Gordon answered with a one-foot dunk off a Jamal Murray assist at 18.2 seconds. Immanuel Quickley missed a 25-foot three-pointer at 1.6 seconds and Nikola Jokic grabbed the defensive rebound, sending the Toronto Raptors to halftime up 67-64 over the Denver Nuggets. Jokic posted 17 points, seven rebounds, and six assists in the first half, while Barrett matched him with 17 points on 5-of-8 shooting.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:00 PM ET 27 minutes ago 2Q | 2:19: Nikola Jokic floater and Scottie Barnes layup keep Raptors up 63-57
 Nikola Jokic sank two free throws at 3:21 after a Collin Murray-Boyles foul, and Scottie Barnes answered with a driving layup for the Toronto Raptors at 3:05. Jokic then hit a six-foot floating jumper off a Christian Braun assist at 2:45 to make it 63-57 for Toronto. After RJ Barrett missed an eight-foot floater at 2:24, Jokic grabbed his sixth rebound alongside 17 points.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:54 PM ET 33 minutes ago 2Q | 5:17: Collin Murray-Boyles and RJ Barrett layups push Toronto up 57-49
 After Marvin Bagley III committed an offensive foul turnover at 5:53 and Nikola Jokic checked back in for the Denver Nuggets, Collin Murray-Boyles scored a one-foot reverse layup assisted by Jamal Shead at 5:39. Jamison Battle then stole a bad pass from Jamal Murray at 5:22, and RJ Barrett finished a running layup off a Scottie Barnes assist at 5:17 to give the Toronto Raptors a 57-49 lead.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:47 PM ET 40 minutes ago 2Q | 7:06: Marvin Bagley III free throw trims Toronto's lead to 47-46
 After RJ Barrett missed a seven-foot pullup jumper at 7:25, Jamal Murray grabbed the defensive rebound for the Denver Nuggets before missing a 16-foot shot at 7:06. Marvin Bagley III collected the offensive rebound, drew a shooting foul on RJ Barrett , and hit a free throw to cut the Toronto Raptors ' lead to 47-46. Nikola Jokic leads Denver with 13 points, five rebounds, and five assists, while Scottie Barnes has 11 points for Toronto.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:41 PM ET an hour ago 2Q | 10:10: Immanuel Quickley triple and Tyus Jones floater put Raptors up 40-37
 Scottie Barnes hit a 16-foot jumper assisted by Immanuel Quickley at 11:35 for the Toronto Raptors, and Jakob Poeltl collected a defensive rebound at 11:08 after a missed three-pointer by Marvin Bagley III. Immanuel Quickley followed with a 25-foot three-pointer off a Scottie Barnes pass at 10:58. Tyus Jones answered for the Denver Nuggets at 10:26 with a seven-foot floater assisted by Trevon Brazile to make it 40-37 with 10:10 remaining in the second quarter.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:36 PM ET an hour ago End of 1Q: Jakob Poeltl late jumper gives Toronto a 35-33 edge over Denver
 Cameron Johnson stole a bad pass from Scottie Barnes at 36.5 seconds, leading to a two-foot basket by Tyus Jones off a Nikola Jokic assist at 26.3 seconds. Jakob Poeltl answered for the Toronto Raptors with an eight-foot jumper at the 7.3-second mark. Cameron Johnson missed a 25-foot three-pointer with 0.7 seconds left as Toronto finished the first quarter leading the Denver Nuggets , 35-33.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:32 PM ET an hour ago 1Q | 2:40: Bryce Hopkins triple pulls Denver within one after Scottie Barnes surge
 Scottie Barnes threw down a dunk assisted by Jamal Shead and added a jumper off an Immanuel Quickley pass for the Toronto Raptors. Bryce Hopkins answered with a three-pointer fed by Jamal Murray to bring the score to Toronto Raptors 26, Denver Nuggets 25 with 2:40 left in the first quarter. Nikola Jokic leads Denver with 10 points, 4 rebounds, and 3 assists, while Barnes paces Toronto with 9 points and 2 steals.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:25 PM ET an hour ago 1Q | 4:08: Aaron Gordon dunk and Trevon Brazile tip-in trim Toronto's lead
 Aaron Gordon threw down a running dunk at 4:53 off an assist from Nikola Jokic , who then stole a bad pass from Jamal Shead at 4:36. After Nikola Jokic missed a 25-foot three-pointer, Trevon Brazile grabbed the offensive rebound and converted a tip-in at 4:26 to cut the Toronto Raptors ' lead to 22-20 over the Denver Nuggets . Nikola Jokic (10 points, 4 rebounds, 3 assists) pulled down a defensive board following a missed 12-foot jumper by Collin Murray-Boyles before Jamal Shead committed a foul at 4:08.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:20 PM ET an hour ago 1Q | 6:57: Scottie Barnes and Collin Murray-Boyles hit triples to lift Toronto
 Collin Murray-Boyles hit a three-pointer assisted by Scottie Barnes before Cameron Johnson answered from deep off a feed from Nikola Jokic . Scottie Barnes then drilled a triple set up by RJ Barrett , and Nikola Jokic scored inside before missing a 7-foot shot at 7:08 that Jamal Shead rebounded. The Toronto Raptors lead the Denver Nuggets 16-12 at 6:57 of the first quarter, with Nikola Jokic scoring 6 points and Collin Murray-Boyles adding 5 points.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 9:14 PM ET an hour ago 1Q | 10:54: Ja'Kobe Walter answers Nikola Jokic from deep to put Toronto ahead
 Scottie Barnes secured the opening tip at 12:00, and Jamal Murray grabbed a defensive rebound after Ja'Kobe Walter missed a 23-foot three-pointer at 11:44. Nikola Jokic put the Denver Nuggets on the board at 11:24 with a 3-foot shot assisted by Christian Braun . Ja'Kobe Walter answered at 11:13 with a 24-foot three-pointer off an Immanuel Quickley assist to give the Toronto Raptors a 3-2 lead.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 8:54 PM ET 2 hours ago Ball Arena tip-off countdown and NBA standings snapshot
 Tip-off at the 19,520-seat Ball Arena in Denver (elevation 5,280 feet) is minutes away as Denver (3-3) hosts fifth-place East contender Toronto (4-3) in the NBA standings . DraftKings lists Denver as a 4.5-point favorite (-191 moneyline) with an over/under of 231.5 points.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 8:50 PM ET 2 hours ago Official ESPN injury report for Nuggets vs Raptors
 Denver Nuggets: Forward Spencer Jones (hamstring) and guard Julian Strawther (knee) are Out; forwards Cameron Johnson and Alpha Diallo are listed as Day-To-Day.
 Toronto Raptors: Forward Kawhi Leonard (knee) and center Nate Bittle (foot) are Out, while center Jakob Poeltl (shoulder) is Day-To-Day.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 8:10 PM ET 2 hours ago Head-to-head schedule: two-game 2026-27 non-conference series
 Wednesday's clash in Mile High is the first of two regular-season meetings between Denver and Toronto in 2026-27. The Nuggets travel north to Scotiabank Arena in Toronto for the rematch on November 29.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 7:29 PM ET 3 hours ago Recent form: last five games for Denver and Toronto
 Denver Nuggets (3-2 in last 5): Oct. 25 vs NO (W 141-135 OT), Oct. 27 vs GS (L 134-114), Oct. 29 at NO (W 104-91), Oct. 31 at PHX (W 127-120) and Nov. 3 vs POR (L 118-110).
 Toronto Raptors (2-3 in last 5): Oct. 25 at MIN (L 117-94), Oct. 28 vs ORL (W 129-99), Oct. 30 vs ORL (L 121-114), Nov. 2 at LAL (L 131-125) and Nov. 3 at LAC (W 125-118).
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 6:56 PM ET 4 hours ago Star matchup: Nikola Jokic and Jamal Murray vs Scottie Barnes and RJ Barrett
 Kitchener, Ontario native Jamal Murray (27.3 PPG) and Nikola Jokic (9.7 RPG, 9.0 APG) square off against Canada's NBA franchise led by Scottie Barnes (24.4 PPG, 7.9 RPG) and Mississauga native RJ Barrett. Last season Toronto went 46-36 allowing 111.8 points per game, while Denver went 54-28 allowing 116.9 points per game.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 6:24 PM ET 4 hours ago Projected starters: Nuggets and Raptors last-game starting lineups
 Denver Nuggets starting five (Nov. 3 vs Portland): Jamal Murray (G), Christian Braun (G), Cameron Johnson (F), Aaron Gordon (F) and Nikola Jokic (C).
 Toronto Raptors starting five (Nov. 3 at LA Clippers): Immanuel Quickley (G), Ja'Kobe Walter (G), RJ Barrett (F), Scottie Barnes (F) and Collin Murray-Boyles (F).
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 6:00 PM ET 4 hours ago How to watch Nuggets vs Raptors in the US and Canada: TV and live stream
 Denver Nuggets vs Toronto Raptors tips off at 9:00 p.m. ET (7:00 p.m. MT, 6:00 p.m. PT) on Wednesday, November 4, at Ball Arena. Viewers in Canada can watch live nationwide on TSN / Sportsnet, while US viewers can tune in on Altitude Sports in Colorado and NBA League Pass, with live quarter-by-quarter updates on VAVEL.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 6:00 PM ET 4 hours ago Toronto Raptors 2026-27 season record and stat leaders
 Under head coach Darko Rajakovic, the Toronto Raptors stand at 4-3 overall (2-2 on the road) following Tuesday's 125-118 road victory over the LA Clippers in Inglewood. Forward Scottie Barnes paces Toronto with 24.4 points and 7.9 rebounds per game, and point guard Immanuel Quickley leads the Raptors with 5.6 assists per contest.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 6:00 PM ET 4 hours ago Denver Nuggets 2026-27 season record and stat leaders
 Coached by David Adelman, the Denver Nuggets enter Wednesday at 3-3 overall (1-2 at Ball Arena) after finishing 54-28 (28-13 at home) in 2025-26. Canadian guard Jamal Murray leads Denver in scoring at 27.3 points per game, while three-time MVP Nikola Jokic leads the Nuggets in both rebounds (9.7 RPG) and assists (9.0 APG).
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 6:00 PM ET 4 hours ago Welcome to Denver Nuggets vs Toronto Raptors live NBA coverage
 Welcome to VAVEL's live play-by-play coverage of the Denver Nuggets (3-3) hosting the Toronto Raptors (4-3) in 2026-27 NBA cross-conference action on Wednesday, November 4, at Ball Arena in Denver. Tip-off is scheduled for 9:00 p.m. ET (7:00 p.m. MT, 02:00 UTC).
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
